user.title: Pair Baby Buddy Dashboard Plus
user.description: In Dashboard Plus, open Care > Settings and create a one-time pairing code. Enter it here within 10 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Dashboard Plus could not be reached. Make sure the add-on is installed and running.
error.invalid_pairing_code: This pairing code is invalid or has expired. Create a new code in Dashboard Plus.

abort.already_configured: Baby Buddy Dashboard Plus is already paired.

get_last_care.name: Get last care
get_last_care.description: Read only the last timestamp of an enabled Care type for the paired child.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Explicitly complete an enabled task for the paired child; no medication record is created.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID shown in Dashboard Plus settings.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: Optional; defaults to today in the add-on timezone.

log_measurement.name: Log measurement
log_measurement.description: Save an enabled measurement directly in Baby Buddy.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: C, cm, kg or g; must match the measurement type.

request_id.name: Request ID
request_id.description: Unique ID; reuse the exact ID and input only for retries.

log_care.name: Log care
log_care.description: Record an explicitly enabled Care entry in Baby Buddy Dashboard Plus.

care_type.name: Care type
care_type.description: A Care type enabled in Dashboard Plus.

category_label.name: Custom category
category_label.description: Required when Care type is custom.

time.name: Time
time.description: Optional; uses the current time when empty.

measurement_api_unavailable.message: The Baby Buddy measurement API is unavailable or outbound writes are disabled in demo mode.

measurement_configuration_missing.message: Configure matching metric or imperial units in Dashboard Plus before recording measurements.

task_not_allowed.message: This task is not enabled for Home Assistant.

task_not_found.message: The task does not exist for the paired child.

task_not_due.message: The task is inactive, an appointment, not due or scheduled in the future.

measurement_not_allowed.message: This measurement type is not enabled for Home Assistant.

measurement_pending.message: The write result is uncertain or still pending. Check Baby Buddy before recording again. Do not retry with a new request ID.

request_conflict.message: This request ID was used with different input. Use a unique ID for each new measurement.

measurement_rejected.message: Baby Buddy rejected the measurement. Check the input and the Baby Buddy connection and permissions.

invalid_action.message: Invalid action input. Check the task, value, unit, date and request ID.

action_not_allowed.message: This action is not enabled in Dashboard Plus.

invalid_auth.message: The pairing is no longer valid. Remove the integration and pair again using a new code.

invalid_care.message: Invalid Care entry. Custom Care requires a category label; check the input length and timestamp.

not_paired.message: Baby Buddy Dashboard Plus has not been paired yet.

not_available.message: Baby Buddy Dashboard Plus is not available.

care_not_allowed.message: This Care type is not enabled for Home Assistant in Dashboard Plus.

cannot_connect.message: Baby Buddy Dashboard Plus cannot be reached.
